{{Quote|Have you seen the new T-17?"<br />"Yeah, look like they modified the ion engine"<br />"I still prefer the T-16's.|Two unnamed stormtroopers on the [[Cairn Installation]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>}}
The '''T-17''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] that was presumably built by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] as a replacement for the venerable [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]. It featured a new development of the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] that gave it a much greater speed than its predecessor.

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The T-17 was mentioned in a conversation between two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the level "Cairn Bay", [[Kyle Katarn]] overheard the conversation while sneaking through the base. The conversation is likely a reference to the conversation between two stormtroopers in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], while [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disables the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], as those two stormtroopers are discussing the [[BT-16 perimeter droid|BT-16]].
